name: Learning reader — book model, chapter format + reader surfaces (design)
objective: Design half of the learning-reader pair: research and settle the book/chapter model (codebase books from phases, subject books for general learning, versioned chapters, Korean/English variants), a native chapter format (refined diagrams, images, multi-column figures, quiz blocks) with a legacy path for existing HTML explainers, then design the reader-first surfaces - library, book page, reader, review - on drafter canvases for phone, iPad and desktop, each job signed on its canvas.

review.note: Design-only phase reviewed whole: S1-S3 contracts settled with every amendment in place; all nine jobs signed on the operator's literal words, snapshots identical to their canvases; job scopes, the 25-line build inventory and the confirmed intent drawn or routed; canvas content sweep clean; Doc impact correctly empty (no product truth changed; P30 owes the frontend.md and decisions.md notes as it builds); Operator Questions 1-13 routed: A1-A5 to the operator, B1-B5 and O2 filed as D41-D46

acceptance.note: design-only, no mockup: the operator signed each job on its canvas
